rootCause: PR 12 removed WorkstationOperationsPanel as part of the intentional System76 migration; RouterHealthPanel was nested inside that component, so unrelated repository-governance health disappeared with it.

The Phase 1 closeout then treated the old primary destination removal as authority to remove the Empire Map, Snapshot, and Sweep bridge path and shared artifact producer, even though those useful global reports had no replacement.

Project registry wiring, the ten non-workstation Infrastructure profiles, Notes modes, Legal, and their shared layout declarations were not removed; the regression was capability coupling and over-broad disposition, not project-data loss or global CSS hiding.
